indications.description: Unresectable/metastatic GIST after imatinib failure or intolerance.
Treatment of clear-cell metastatic renal-cell carcinoma on the 21-day sunitinib schedule.

treatment.schedule_summary: Sunitinib 50 mg orally daily Days 1–14; Days 15–21 off. Repeat until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

action.message: Grade 3–4 reactions: delay until recovery to grade 1, then reduce one 12.5 mg dose level. Component-specific stop criteria override this general pathway.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 reactions: delay until recovery to grade 1, then reduce one 12.5 mg dose level. Component-specific stop criteria override this general pathway.

action.message: A prior grade 3–4 reaction has not recovered to grade 1 or better; continue withholding.

action.message: A documented prior grade 3–4 event needs an entered current grade showing recovery to grade 1 or better. Missing recovery cannot be cleared by a stage selection or restart checkbox.

rules.explanation: A documented prior grade 3–4 event needs an entered current grade showing recovery to grade 1 or better. Missing recovery cannot be cleared by a stage selection or restart checkbox.

action.message: After recovery from grade 3–4 toxicity, review one 12.5 mg level reduction from the actual current dose; minimum 25 mg/day. Recovery is not an automatic restart.

rules.explanation: After recovery from grade 3–4 toxicity, review one 12.5 mg level reduction from the actual current dose; minimum 25 mg/day. Recovery is not an automatic restart.

action.message: A dose below 25 mg/day is outside the source dose range; reconcile the prescription.

action.message: Avoid potent CYP 3 A 4 inhibitors/inducers where possible. If unavoidable, specialist exceptions may involve 37.5 mg minimum with inhibitor or up to 87.5 mg with inducer; these are not routine dose changes or automatic prescriptions.

action.message: If signs of SJS, TEN or erythema multiforme are present, discontinue sunitinib and assess urgently. A resolved suspected EM event may be reviewed separately; confirmed SJS/TEN must not be restarted.

eligibility: Indication as listed in the current official NCCP regimen
Performance status and age/treatment-setting eligibility appropriate to the selected indication
Adequate organ and bone-marrow function for the selected regimen
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: Baseline and regular full blood count, renal/liver profile, thyroid function and blood pressure.
MUGA/ECHO if clinically indicated or cardiac history; periodic LVEF assessment may be considered.
The 00719 source does not assign 00325’s fixed 12-week TFT interval; specify local timing explicitly.
Monitor skin, bleeding, thyroid dysfunction, QT risk and wound healing.
dose_modifications: Only the currently structured inputs and decision rules are operational in SACTCheck. Renal and hepatic source requirements may still require manual review of the current official NCCP PDF.

administration.note: Reference starting dose; individual prescription may be lower. Days 15–21 are tablet-free. With/without food; no extra dose after a missed dose.
